# PUMP package

Last updated: January 2025.

![PUMP icon](reference/figures/pump_icon.png)

Authors:

- Zarni Htet
- Kristen Hunter
- Luke Miratrix
- Kristin Porter

## Documentation

<https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/>

Using [pkgdown](https://pkgdown.r-lib.org/).

## Description

For randomized controlled trials (RCTs) with a single intervention being
measured on multiple outcomes, researchers often apply a multiple
testing procedure (such as Bonferroni or Benjamini-Hochberg) to adjust
$p$-values. Such an adjustment reduces the likelihood of spurious
findings, but also changes the statistical power, sometimes
substantially, which reduces the probability of detecting effects when
they do exist. However, this consideration is frequently ignored in
typical power analyses, as existing tools do not easily accommodate the
use of multiple testing procedures.

We introduce the PUMP R package as a tool for analysts to estimate
statistical power, minimum detectable effect size, and sample size
requirements for multi-level RCTs with multiple outcomes. Multiple
outcomes are accounted for in two ways. First, power estimates from PUMP
properly account for the adjustment in $p$-values from applying a
multiple testing procedure. Second, as researchers change their focus
from one outcome to multiple outcomes, different definitions of
statistical power emerge.

PUMP allows researchers to consider a variety of definitions of power,
as some may be more appropriate for the goals of their study. The
package estimates power for frequentist multi-level mixed effects
models, and supports a variety of commonly-used RCT designs and models
and multiple testing procedures. In addition to the main functionality
of estimating power, minimum detectable effect size, and sample size
requirements, the package allows the user to easily explore sensitivity
of these quantities to changes in underlying assumptions.

Please see the vignettes for examples of how to use this package.

## The hot-off-the-press version

Our package is on CRAN, but you can install the latest version on GitHub
via:

    devtools::install_github("https://github.com/MDRCNY/PUMP" )

The latest version has some bug fixes and extra features, and we
strongly recommend using it over the CRAN version.

## A small illustration

We provide below one example of using PUMP to calculate a minimium
detectable effect size (MDES). The user specifies the RCT design and
model (d_m), the multiple testing procedure (MTP, in this case Holm),
the target power (0.8), and the type of power desired (individual power
for outcome 1). The user also specifies a variety of design and model
parameters, such as the number of outcomes, sample sizes at different
levels, variation explained by covariates, etc.

    m <- pump_mdes(
      d_m = "d3.2_m3fc2rc",         # choice of design and analysis strategy
      MTP = "HO",                   # multiple testing procedure
      target.power = 0.80,          # desired power
      power.definition = "D1indiv", # power type
      M = 5,                        # number of outcomes
      J = 3,                        # number of schools per block
      K = 21,                       # number districts
      nbar = 258,                   # average number of students per school
      Tbar = 0.50,                  # prop treated
      alpha = 0.05,                 # significance level
      numCovar.1 = 5,               # number of covariates at level 1
      numCovar.2 = 3,               # number of covariates at level 2
      R2.1 = 0.1, R2.2 = 0.7,       # explanatory power of covariates for each level
      ICC.2 = 0.05, ICC.3 = 0.4,    # intraclass correlation coefficients
      rho = 0.4 )                   # how correlated outcomes are

# Package index

## All functions

- [`calc_df()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/calc_df.md) :
  Calculate degrees of freedom (support function)
- [`check_cor()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/check_cor.md)
  : Check correlation of test statistics (simulation function)
- [`convert_params()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/convert_params.md)
  : Converts model params into DGP params (simulation function)
- [`gen_T.x()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/gen_T.x.md) :
  Generate treatment assignment vector (simulation function)
- [`gen_Yobs()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/gen_Yobs.md) :
  Generate observed outcomes (simulation function)
- [`gen_base_sim_data()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/gen_base_sim_data.md)
  : Generate base simulated multi-level data (simulation function)
- [`gen_cluster_ids()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/gen_cluster_ids.md)
  : Generates school and district assignments (simulation function)
- [`gen_corr_matrix()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/gen_corr_matrix.md)
  : Generate correlation matrix (simulation function)
- [`gen_sim_data()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/gen_sim_data.md)
  : Generate simulated multi-level data (simulation function)
- [`get_power_results()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/get_power_results.md)
  : Calculates different definitions of power (support function)
- [`parse_d_m()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/parse_d_m.md)
  : Return characteristics of a given context/d_m code (support
  function)
- [`plot(`*`<pumpgridresult>`*`)`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/plot.pumpgridresult.md)
  : Plot a pumpgridresult object (result function)
- [`plot(`*`<pumpresult>`*`)`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/plot.pumpresult.md)
  : Plot a pumpresult object (result function)
- [`power_curve()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/power_curve.md)
  : Obtain a power curve for a range of sample size or MDES values
- [`print_context()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/print_context.md)
  : Print context (design, model, parameter values) of pumpresult or
  pumpgridresult (result function)
- [`pump_info()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pump_info.md)
  : Provides details about supported package features (core function)
- [`pump_mdes()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pump_mdes.md)
  : Estimate the minimum detectable effect size (MDES) (core function)
- [`pump_mdes_grid()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pump_mdes_grid.md)
  : Run pump_mdes on varying values of parameters (grid function)
- [`pump_power()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pump_power.md)
  : Estimate power across definitions (core function)
- [`pump_power_grid()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pump_power_grid.md)
  : Run pump_power on varying values of parameters (grid function)
- [`pump_sample()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pump_sample.md)
  : Estimate the required sample size (core function)
- [`pump_sample_grid()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pump_sample_grid.md)
  : Run pump_sample on varying values of parameters (grid function)
- [`is.pumpgridresult()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pumpgridresult.md)
  [`print(`*`<pumpgridresult>`*`)`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pumpgridresult.md)
  [`summary(`*`<pumpgridresult>`*`)`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pumpgridresult.md)
  : Result object for results of grid power calculations
- [`params()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pumpresult.md)
  [`d_m()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pumpresult.md)
  [`design()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pumpresult.md)
  [`search_path()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pumpresult.md)
  [`pump_type()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pumpresult.md)
  [`is.pumpresult()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pumpresult.md)
  [`` `[`( ``*`<pumpresult>`*`)`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pumpresult.md)
  [`` `[[`( ``*`<pumpresult>`*`)`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pumpresult.md)
  [`dim(`*`<pumpresult>`*`)`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pumpresult.md)
  [`summary(`*`<pumpresult>`*`)`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pumpresult.md)
  [`print(`*`<pumpresult>`*`)`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pumpresult.md)
  [`as.data.frame(`*`<pumpresult>`*`)`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/pumpresult.md)
  : pumpresult object for results of power calculations
- [`transpose_power_table()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/transpose_power_table.md)
  : Convert power table from wide to long (result function)
- [`update(`*`<pumpgridresult>`*`)`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/update.pumpgridresult.md)
  : Update a pump grid call, tweaking some parameters (core function)
- [`update(`*`<pumpresult>`*`)`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/update.pumpresult.md)
  : Update a pump call, tweaking some parameters (core function)
- [`update_grid()`](https://mdrcny.github.io/PUMP/reference/update_grid.md)
  : Update a single pump call to a grid call (grid function)
